name: Liquid Compute GPU Test
tagline: Run GPU acceptance tests (DCGM, GEMM, HBM/PCIe bandwidth, NCCL) on NVIDIA GPU nodes you administer.
description: Run GPU acceptance tests on NVIDIA GPU nodes you administer. Liquid Compute connects over SSH from its own servers and runs NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics, a CUTLASS GEMM benchmark, HBM and PCIe bandwidth tests and NCCL all-reduce, then reports each measurement against the GPU profile's thresholds (A10, H100, H200, B200, B300; single nodes and 2- or 4-node RDMA clusters). Nothing is installed on the node: you add one `authorized_keys` line and remove it afterwards. Adding nodes and starting a test require your explicit confirmation, enforced by the server. Free; requires a Liquid Compute account.

install.notes: Uses OAuth. Sign in with your Liquid Compute account when prompted (create one at https://liquidcompute.com).
